import Mathlib
import Nodes.«erdos-257--h2».Context

/-! Hole `h_core` of a merged partial proof, as a node (D-12 #5, D-29).
Statement generated by the gate from the assembly; immutable (D-3). -/

theorem erdos_257__h2 : ∀ (r : ℚ) (G : Set ℕ),
  (0 : ℕ) ∉ G →
    (∀ (n : ℕ),
        (1 : ℕ) ≤ n →
          (n ∈ G ↔
            (1 : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - (1 : ℝ)) ≤
              (↑r : ℝ) - ∑' (a : (↑(G ∩ Set.Iio n) : Type)), (1 : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (↑a : ℕ) - (1 : ℝ)))) →
      ∑' (n : (↑G : Type)), (1 : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (↑n : ℕ) - (1 : ℝ)) = (↑r : ℝ) → G.Finite := by
  sorry

witness.text:
import Mathlib

theorem witness : ∃ (r : ℚ) (G : Set ℕ),
  (0 : ℕ) ∉ G ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ),
        (1 : ℕ) ≤ n →
          (n ∈ G ↔
            (1 : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - (1 : ℝ)) ≤
              (↑r : ℝ) - ∑' (a : (↑(G ∩ Set.Iio n) : Type)), (1 : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (↑a : ℕ) - (1 : ℝ)))) ∧
      ∑' (n : (↑G : Type)), (1 : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (↑n : ℕ) - (1 : ℝ)) = (↑r : ℝ) := by
  refine ⟨0, ∅, Set.notMem_empty 0, ?_, by rw [tsum_empty]; simp⟩
  intro n hn
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    calc (2 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hn
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1) := by
    apply div_pos one_pos; linarith
  haveI : IsEmpty (↑((∅ : Set ℕ) ∩ Set.Iio n) : Type) := ⟨fun x => x.2.1⟩
  rw [tsum_empty]
  simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, false_iff, not_le]
  simpa using hpos
